OUR STORY

About Muscat Music & Art Academy

A place in Muscat where arts education, practice and cultural participation meet.

Since its founding in 2019, the academy has offered music, visual arts and movement learning for children and adults, connecting lessons with practice and artistic participation.

01

Our vision

To give every learner a welcoming entry to the arts and room to build skills, confidence and a connection with the community.

02

Our mission

To offer structured arts learning that encourages exploration, regular practice and connections with cultural and educational institutions.

FOUNDER / المؤسس

From education and public service to the academy

FOUNDER & CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

H.E. Dr Sharifa bint Khalfan bin Nasser Al Yahyai

Former Minister of Social Development · Omani academic and researcher

Dr Sharifa has led Muscat Music & Art Academy since its founding in 2019. Her career spans education, research and national service, with a focus on creating opportunities for emerging artistic talent.

Academic background
  1. 1992BA in Arabic Language and Literature, Sultan Qaboos University
  2. 1995MA in Modern Literature, Sultan Qaboos University
  3. 2001PhD in Arabic and Middle Eastern Studies, University of Leeds
Career milestones
  1. 2004–2011Minister of Social Development, Sultanate of Oman
  2. 2018Arab Woman of the Year Award for social development
  3. 2019Founded Muscat Music & Art Academy
  4. 2025Signed a cooperation programme with the National Museum
A message from the founder

The academy seeks to give people a real opportunity to discover and develop their talents, making arts education part of personal growth and community life.

Editorial summary based on the academy’s activities; not a direct quotation from the founder.
